title: Clear pass: landing copy that meets every requirement
demand: Landing-page hero copy for a note-taking app. Under 60 words. Must mention the free tier and that no credit card is needed. No hype words (revolutionary, game-changing, best ever, synergy).
rubric: Fulfilled only if every explicit requirement is met. Count words; any listed hype word fails it.
delivery: Write it down before it slips away. Notes syncs across your phone and laptop, works offline, and searches every page in a blink. Start on the free tier today, with three notebooks and no credit card needed.
